content:
Priya: Quick heads-up on Luminar preview - they were allocated 20 seats but analytics shows only 4 active. Evan, any blockers on your side?

Evan: Hey all, thanks for checking. We're stuck on SSO + a UI permission mismatch. Platform team asked for a rotated IdP cert before they approve the final SAML assertion. Also our admin reported that the Console 'routes' page shows dead links for the dev key.

Aaron: @Evan I can pair on the SAML rotation tomorrow morning. Can you share the current metadata file in this thread? Also will run a quick console check to reproduce the broken link.

Nora: I put a trimmed enablement checklist for Luminar here: https://redwood.app/playbooks/luminar-quickstart - it's the 5-step admin flow we usually run for previews (users, SSO, seats, smoke run, feedback).

infra-bot: deployment: preview-stack/luminar updated at 2026-03-18T09:12Z. Logs archived to /infra/logs/luminar/preview-20260318.tar.gz

Evan: Sharing metadata now via DM. Also can the team advise on minimum usage thresholds we should show execs to avoid a premature renewal flag?

Priya: I'll draft a one-pager success rubric: baseline = 50 unique API calls/day OR 15 active seats with admin actions completed, plus 3 quality-check prompts. If neither happens by day 21 mark, we'll trigger renewal outreach. I'll attach a 2-question post-onboard survey (ease + usefulness).

Aaron: To speed the smoke validation after SAML, here's a tiny curl I use locally - will run it during the call once tokens are ready:

```
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.test/v1/chat
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEMP"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}],"max_tokens":5}'
```

Aaron: I'll paste the exact token scope we need and a checklist step to validate the Console route link.

Nora: Proposed plan: 1) Aaron/Nora pairing at 09:30 PT to rotate IdP cert + validate links, 2) Priya posts rubric + survey by EOD, 3) Luminar completes the quickstart checklist and confirms seat counts, 4) follow-up triage in 7 days to review telemetry.

Priya: I'll create the invite and include the rubric + survey URL. Also flagging Luminar as 'at-risk' in the account notes so Sales sees it. Adding tags: preview, saml, renewal-watch. :eyes:

Evan: Appreciated. We'll prioritize the SSO windows tomorrow and confirm seats after. Can we also get a short note on what console telemetry we should monitor? Execs want simple KPIs.

Priya: I'll include telemetry KPIs in the one-pager: daily active seats, avg response latency for test prompts, error rate on auth flows, and number of admin actions completed. Short, digestible.

Aaron: Bring any failing logs to the pairing and I'll triage immediately. If we hit infra edge cases I'll escalate to infra on-call.

Evan: Sounds good. Thanks team.

Priya: Thanks everyone - posting calendar invite now and will upload the rubric+survey here once ready.
